name: ballerina/smb
description: This module provides an SMB client and an SMB server listener implementation to facilitate connections to remote SMB (Server Message Block) file shares. SMB is a network file sharing protocol that allows applications to read and write to files and request services from server programs in a computer network.

functions.name: next
functions.description: Reads and return the next `byte[]` chunk of the stream.

return.description:
A `record` of `byte[]`s when the stream is available,
`()` if the stream has reached the end or else an `error`

functions.name: close
functions.description:
Closes the stream. The primary usage of this function is to close the stream without reaching the end.
If the stream reaches the end, the `contentByteStream.next` will automatically close the stream.

return.description: Returns `()` when the closing was successful or an `error`

return.description:

functions.name: 'start
functions.description:
Starts the SMB listener and begins monitoring for file changes.
```ballerina
error? response = listener.'start();
```

functions.name: attach
functions.description:
Attaches an SMB service to the listener.
```ballerina
error? response = listener.attach(service1);
```

return.description: `()` or else an `error` upon failure to attach the service

functions.name: putCsv
functions.description:
Writes CSV content to a file on an SMB share.
Supports both array-of-arrays (string[][]) and array-of-records formats.
When not appending, automatically adds headers for record arrays.
```ballerina
string[][] csvData = [["name", "age"], ["John", "30"], ["Jane", "25"]];
smb:Error? response = caller->putCsv(path, csvData, smb:OVERWRITE);
```

parameters.name: content
parameters.description: CSV content as array of arrays or array of records

return.description: `()` or else an `smb:Error` if the operation fails

services.name: Service
services.description: Consumes files found in the watched directory on the SMB share, dispatching each to the handler matching its content type.

listener.name: smb:Listener
listener.description: Polls the watched directory on the SMB share on its configured interval and dispatches each file event to the attached service.

constraints.message: An SMB service must declare at least one onFile* handler or onFileDelete, otherwise nothing is ever dispatched. onError alone does not count.
An SMB service needs its watched path from exactly one source: @smb:ServiceConfig { path } or the service identifier.

methods.name: onFileText
methods.description: Invoked for each .txt, .log, or .md file found in the watched directory. Falls through to onFile when not declared.

parameters.name: caller

parameters.name: fileInfo
parameters.description: The file's name, path, size, timestamps, and attributes.

methods.name: onFileJson
methods.description: Invoked for each .json file found in the watched directory. Falls through to onFile when not declared.

parameters.name: content
parameters.description: The parsed content, bind a record type to project it, see the jsonContent data-binding rule.

methods.description: Invoked for each .xml file found in the watched directory. Falls through to onFile when not declared.

parameters.name: content
parameters.description: The parsed content, bind a record type to project it, see the xmlContent data-binding rule.

parameters.name: caller
parameters.description: The share connection, for reading or writing other files while this one is being processed.

parameters.name: fileInfo
parameters.description: The file's name, path, size, timestamps, and attributes.

methods.name: onFileCsv
methods.description: Invoked for each .csv file found in the watched directory. Declaring a stream parameter reads the file in chunks instead of loading it into memory.

parameters.name: content
parameters.description: The parsed rows, see the csvContent data-binding rule for the batched and streamed forms.

parameters.name: caller
parameters.description: The share connection, for reading or writing other files while this one is being processed.

parameters.name: fileInfo
parameters.description: The file's name, path, size, timestamps, and attributes.

methods.name: onFile
methods.description: Invoked for any file no typed handler matched, and as the fallback when a typed handler is not declared. Content arrives as raw bytes.

parameters.name: content
parameters.description: The file's bytes. Declare the stream form to read large files in chunks rather than loading them into memory.

parameters.name: caller
parameters.description: The share connection, for reading or writing other files while this one is being processed.

parameters.name: fileInfo
parameters.description: The file's name, path, size, timestamps, and attributes.

methods.name: onFileDelete
methods.description: Invoked when a file disappears from the watched directory. There is no content and no file metadata, because the file is already gone.

parameters.name: path
parameters.description: Path of the file that was deleted.

parameters.name: caller
parameters.description: The share connection, for acting on the share in response to the deletion.

methods.name: onError
methods.description: Invoked when the listener fails to poll, read, or bind a file, and when a handler itself returns an error. Without it, failures are logged and polling continues.

parameters.name: caller
parameters.description: The share connection, for acting on the share while handling the failure.

annotations.name: FunctionConfig
annotations.description: The annotation to configure an SMB content handler method.

annotations.name: ServiceConfig
annotations.description: The annotation to configure an SMB service.
